Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment combines AP-MS for complex identification and specific PTM analysis focusing on cysteine sulfinylation (redox modification) at C672. Cross-linking MS (XL-MS) using BS3 was also performed, though the primary PRIDE metadata focuses on the oxidative modification analysis.

scope: The supernatant was incubated with Flag affinity beads (Smart-Lifesciences SA042025) for 2.5 h at 4 °C to selectively capture the SPATA5 complex through the Flag tag on various forms of SPATA5.
Proteins were purified using affinity beads, and after separation by SDS-PAGE, gel bands containing SPATA5 and SPATA5L1 were excised.

The objective of this project was to identify oxidative modifications of the SPATA5 protein in C672 cells through proteomic analysis. This involved the affinity purification of SPATA5 under overexpression conditions, followed by detailed proteomic analysis to characterize the oxidative modifications.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on the SPATA5 complex specifically isolated via Flag-affinity purification from HEK293F cells.
